title: Long way to be told
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The uncle's opinion, unasked: Portland's a long way to go to be told no by strangers when you can get it here for free. Gully says they said yes. The uncle says then it's a longer way.

panels.composition: The shack. The UNCLE on his pot. GULLY. WOOD with BARNABY, not having said anything.

balloons.text: Portland's a long way to be told no by strangers. Get it here free.

panels.composition: The shack. Wood in the door. The bay through the window behind the uncle. He hasn't said a word this strip and won't. The uncle's is the last one.
